release_notes:
Scrolling the Settings tab with the mouse wheel no longer changes the setting under the pointer, such as Typing speed: the page scrolls instead. Dropdowns elsewhere, such as Folder in the editor, work the same way

Settings are grouped into cards. Expansion method and Trigger behavior are now explained choices, and settings that apply to only one of them, such as Typing speed or the clipboard restore delay, are greyed out until that choice is picked

A bar at the bottom shows when you have unsaved changes, with Revert and Save settings (Ctrl+S). Leaving the tab, closing Snippets or updating with unsaved changes asks whether to save them first
